stage1.impression: A clean, well-conceived range shot: eight tinted cabinets in spectrum order on pale paper, back-lit so the horns throw coloured light onto the floor, and the colour idea reads at a glance. It still reads as CG: a row of identical clones on a flat, slightly magenta paper with no tooth visible, heavy grey slab shadows that outweigh the coloured light, black holes where the horn drivers sit, and a soft, denoised finish.

blocking_9: Neutral paper: wall and floor within delta-E 2.5 of #EEECE7, with no green deficit (g_median within 2 of r_median and b_median)
Coloured light, not grey shadow, is the dominant floor event: the cabinet shadows lighter and shorter, every speaker's coloured patch joined to its shadow and fully inside the frame
No crushed blacks in the products: the horn throats and the smoked speaker's woofer show detail (crush_pct under 10 in the throats, smoked woofer lum_median above 25)
The arc reads as depth, not as a flat row of identical copies
Visible paper tooth and crisp edges at full size, with no denoiser smear on the acrylic edges and the floor

defects.what: Wall has a magenta cast: RGB 239/234/239, delta-E 5.8 against the specified paper #EEECE7
Foreground floor is pinkish grey (220/213/214), delta-E 6.6 against the paper; it reads as tinted plastic, not paper
Cabinet shadows are dense, flat neutral grey slabs (lum 119 against floor 217), the heaviest thing on the floor, and they make the colour read as an afterthought
The red speaker's shadow and colour patch run off the left edge of the frame
The smoked speaker's shadow runs off the right edge of the frame
Every horn throat is a black hole: the compression driver crushes to 0 (67-73 % crushed), so the horns read as pasted silhouettes
The smoked speaker is close to lost: woofer median lum 11, 4-5 % of the cabinet crushed, so there is no detail in the ring or cone
Eight identical models at equal spacing and turn; the 0.9 m arc barely reads, so it looks like a repeated asset row rather than an arranged set
The coloured patches from the horns sit detached beyond the grey shadows, read as floating blobs, and their saturation is modest (blue patch 132/153/180)
Overall softness and denoiser smear: no visible paper tooth at full size, acrylic edges up to 14 px wide on the lit side, and low global contrast

changes.problem: The whole frame carries a magenta cast, so the paper reads as pink plastic and every colour is off-true.

evidence.measured: RGB median 239/234/239, delta-E 5.84 against #EEECE7; floor 0 560 1280 640 at 220/213/214, delta-E 6.61

change.setting: render: white balance (add a green tint), with the cyc softbox matched to the key
change.from: 5400 K, no tint; cyc 5600 K against key 5200 K
change.to: 5300 K with a +6 green tint (or whatever brings G up to R), cyc 5300 K

changes.expected: The wall sits at about 238/236/231, warm paper white, and the floor is a slightly darker, neutral-warm version of the same paper.

changes.problem: The grey cabinet shadows are long and dense enough to outweigh the coloured light, and the outer ones leave the frame.

evidence.measured: shadow lum 119 against lit floor 217 (ratio 0.55); shadows at x 0-60 and 1150-1280 cropped by the frame edge

changes.expected: The shadows are about 30 % shorter, the horn's coloured patch lands closer to its cabinet's shadow, and all eight shadows and patches end inside the frame by at least 40 px.

changes.problem: Shadow density is too high for back-lit pale paper, so the shadows read as black-grey slabs instead of soft, open shade.
changes.expected: The cabinet shadows open to lum about 145-160 while the coloured patches keep their hue, so colour against white becomes the event and the grey supports it.

changes.problem: The horn throats crush to pure black in every speaker, which reads as a cut-out and kills the horn's depth.

change.setting: strip: strength and position (linked to the compression driver)
change.to: 45 W/m2 at (0, -4, 2.6), so it looks down each horn's axis; or add a second 9 x 0.3 m strip linked to the compression drivers only, at 30 W/m2

changes.expected: Each throat shows the driver's phase plug and housing in dark grey, with readable form and no 0-value hole.

changes.problem: The smoked black speaker is nearly lost, its woofer ring and cone indistinguishable.

change.setting: sides: strip strength (right strip), plus face
change.to: right strip 10 W/m2 (left stays at 6), face 5.0 W/m2

changes.expected: The smoked cabinet shows a clean edge highlight on its right side and the cone separates from its ring; the other cabinets brighten only slightly.

changes.problem: The line reads as a flat row of identical copies; the arc gives almost no depth or rhythm.

evidence.measured: speaker heights are visually equal across the row; spacing and turn are uniform

change.from: middle 0.9 m farther than the ends; +12.0 deg toward the middle
change.to: middle 2.0 m farther than the ends; +18 deg toward the middle

changes.expected: The end speakers read noticeably larger than the middle pair (about 8-10 % taller), the floor shadows fan out, and the set reads as an arranged curve with depth.

changes.problem: The paper shows no tooth at full size, so the ground reads as a smooth CG plane.

evidence.measured: lum_range 7.5 over the whole foreground band, with only smooth vignetting (211.6 to 216.6 across x)

change.setting: paper: tooth and mottle; render samples
change.to: tooth 0.7 at 1.5 mm, mottle 0.08, 256 samples with the denoiser on albedo and normal passes

changes.expected: A fine paper grain is visible in the foreground at full size without reading as noise, and the floor's local range rises.

changes.problem: The finish is flat and soft, and the products lack the micro-contrast of a campaign print.

evidence.measured: lit-side cabinet edge width_10_90 14 px; global p1 3 to p99 242 with a contrast of 0.08

changes.expected: The acrylic edges and ribs read crisply, the paper stays below 242, and no halos appear at the cabinet edges.

out_of_scope.request: Make the side panels of the cabinets show more of their tint instead of a grey-white lining
out_of_scope.why: The opaque white batts and their placement are part of the speaker, which is fixed

out_of_scope.request: Let more coloured light through the cabinet bodies so the main shadow is tinted rather than grey
out_of_scope.why: The linings are opaque by design; only the clear parts and the horn pass colour, so the speaker cannot change
